title: Udyam Registration Checklist Status
subtitle: Complete both the document extractions and manual form values below to audit your Udyam filing readiness.
emptyChecklist: Upload identity and business proof documents to view checklist audit status.

aadhaarNumber.label: Aadhaar Number
aadhaarNumber.explanation: Your Aadhaar card verifies your identity as the owner of the business. It helps prevent identity theft and ensures only you can manage your registration.

panNumber.label: Individual PAN
panNumber.explanation: Your PAN card is used to link your business activities with tax records. It is a mandatory requirement to verify your financial identity.

name.label: Entrepreneur Name
name.explanation: This is your official name as shown on your government ID. It must match your Aadhaar card so the system can confirm you are the authorized owner.

businessName.label: Enterprise Name
businessName.explanation: This is the official name of your shop or enterprise. It will be printed on your final registration certificate so customers and banks can identify your business.

businessAddress.label: Business Address
businessAddress.explanation: This is the physical location where your business operates. The government uses this to map where industries are located and send any official mail.

businessType.label: Organization Type
businessType.explanation: This describes how your business is legally owned, such as a sole owner, a partnership, or a private company. It determines which rules and tax laws apply to you.

panOfBusiness.label: Business PAN
panOfBusiness.explanation: This is the separate tax registration card for your business. It is only needed if your business is registered as a partnership or private company rather than owned solely by you.

gstin.label: GSTIN
gstin.explanation: Used for verifying your business with tax departments. Needed if your enterprise is GST registered.

bankAccountNumber.label: Bank Account Number
bankAccountNumber.explanation: The account number where subsidies and scheme payouts are credited.

ifscCode.label: IFSC Code
ifscCode.explanation: The unique branch code used to ensure bank transfers route correctly to your branch.

mobileNumber.label: Aadhaar-Linked Mobile
mobileNumber.explanation: The mobile number linked with your Aadhaar, used to sign documents via OTP.

nicCode.label: NIC Activity Code
nicCode.explanation: A classification code representing the exact nature of your business activities.

investment.label: Investment Figure (INR)
investment.explanation: The total capital invested in plant, machinery, or equipment.

turnover.label: Turnover Figure (INR)
turnover.explanation: The total sales or revenue generated by your business during the financial year.
